newsitem.title: USA: Loehmann's says sales trends remained weak.
newsitem.headline: Loehmann's says sales trends remained weak.

text.p: Loehmann's Inc on Thursday said its April sales trends remained weak despite efforts to increase traffic at its clothing stores.
"As April progressed, the sales trends that negatively impacted our business in the quarter did not improve," company president Robert N. Friedman said in a statement.

Loehmann's today reported first quarter earnings of $0.04 per share, or $0.03 on a pro forma basis. Both figures were below First Call's consensus estimate of $0.06 per share and well short of the $0.27 per share the women's apparel retailer earned on a pro forma basis in last year's quarter.
